raw_response:
I was lucky to get coupons for fertilizer through FISP this year, so I will apply some of that NPK and urea on this maize plot and use the hybrid seed they gave me. The plot is small, so my family can manage the ridging, planting, and weeding without hiring ganyu labor. I will not waste money on pesticides or irrigation since the rains are enough for maize here in Machinga, and I do not have manure to spread.
